description: This file defines a report for assessment plan status in the ERPNext education module, including functions to fetch assessment data, generate charts, and define report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and chart based on filters.

methods.name: get_assessment_data
methods.description: Fetches assessment plan data and computes chart data.

methods.name: get_assessment_result
methods.description: Retrieves assessment result counts grouped by assessment plan and docstatus.

methods.name: get_chart
methods.description: Generates chart data structure from assessment counts.

methods.name: get_column
methods.description: Defines the columns for the assessment plan status report.
